title: Degreewise small products of Kan complexes are products of spaces
statement: Use simplicial sets, Kan complexes, degreewise products, weak homotopy equivalences, coherent diagrams, cones and limiting cones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the infinity category $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathbf{Kan}_{\mathcal W})$ of $\mathcal W$-small spaces of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Let $J$ be a $\mathcal W$-small set, possibly empty, and let $(K_j)_{j\in J}$ be $\mathcal W$-small Kan complexes. Their degreewise product $\prod_{j\in J}K_j$ is a Kan complex, and its projections $\prod_jK_j\to K_j$, regarded as a cone in $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ over the diagram $j\mapsto K_j$ indexed by the discrete simplicial set $J$, form a limiting cone. Thus $\prod_jK_j$ is a product of the $K_j$ in $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$; for $J$ empty this says that $\Delta^0$ is terminal. Moreover, if $f_j:K_j\to L_j$ are weak homotopy equivalences between Kan complexes, then $\prod_jf_j$ is a weak homotopy equivalence.
